preachMode.blackout: Press B or click to continue

bible.notFound: Could not find text. Check reference.

fidelityReview.title: Fidelity review
fidelityReview.toastError: We couldn't complete the review. Try again.
fidelityReview.empty: The review hasn't run for this sermon yet. It evaluates, marker by marker, whether the cited source supports the preceding sentence.
fidelityReview.noMarkers: This sermon has no citation markers to review.
fidelityReview.jumpToMarker: Jump to marker {{marker}} in the sermon

banner.pass: The citations support the draft's claims.
banner.soft: Some citations only partly support the claim. Review the flagged markers before publishing.
banner.hard: Too many markers are unsupported or contradict their source. Fix the citations before publishing.

contraScan.selectedHint: Write below how you answer this objection ↓

noDissent.title: No contrary positions found
noDissent.description: We searched your library for voices that dissent from your central idea and found none.
noDissent.invite: Consider adding sources that represent other faithful traditions. Engaging the strongest objection makes your preaching sturdier — and we never invent a contrary position that isn't in a real resource.

dissent.title: Before publishing: hear the whole counsel
dissent.description: These resources in your library push in a different direction than your central idea. Consider at least one before you step into the pulpit (Acts 20:27).
dissent.step: Select the objection you'll engage ({{count}} from your library):

note.label: How do you answer this objection from the text?
note.hint: Your reflection, in your words. We don't write it for you. If the objection convinces you, go back and adjust that point of the sermon.

override.label: Justify why you publish without recording a consideration
override.placeholder: Explain your decision (at least {{min}} characters). It is logged.

toast.error: We couldn't record the review. Please try again.
toast.gateError: You must consider a contrary position or justify your decision before publishing.

fidelityGate.softDescription: Some citations only partly support what the draft claims. You can fix those markers or proceed by recording your pastoral justification.
fidelityGate.hardDescription: Too many markers are unsupported or contradict their source. Fix those citations before publishing — this block has no exception.

override.label: Why are you publishing despite the findings?
override.placeholder: Explain your pastoral decision carefully (at least {{min}} characters)…

plurality.title: Biblical plurality
plurality.description: These doctrinal claims rest on a single passage. A weight-bearing claim should stand on at least two biblical witnesses.

authority.title: Authority subordination
authority.description: These claims lean on a confession, creed, or theologian as the final authority. The ground must be the text; the confession is a witness, not the ground.

attribution.title: Source attribution
attribution.description: These sources require attribution under their licence, but the data to render it is missing. Review the resource in your library before publishing.

toast.error: We couldn't publish the sermon. Try again.
toast.reviewFailed: We couldn't check fidelity. Try again.

attributions.title: Attributions
attributions.description: License-required attributions for the sources cited in this sermon.
